info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Leasing Details API
info.description: The Leasing Details API allows users to retrieve comprehensive information about specific leasing contracts. By using a unique leasing identifier, consumers can access vital data such as contract terms, financial obligations, and associated assets. This endpoint is typically utilized by financial institutions, leasing companies, and their partners to gain insights into leasing arrangements for better decision-making and customer support. Whether for auditing, data management, or customer service purposes, this API serves as a critical resource for effective leasing operations.

get.summary: Retrieve leasing details by resource ID
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed leasing information associated with a specific resource ID. By providing the appropriate resource identifier, developers can access relevant leasing data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a GET operation for leasing information regarding a specific deposit lending resource identified by RES-100045. It requires application/json format and adheres to the schema definitions outlined in the components section.
